samples.question: Four panels read top to bottom. Every panel shows the same five slot columns and a shaded vertical band (the region) that always covers the middle column. Four tokens - one red, one green, one blue, one orange - sit in the slots, with exactly one token per occupied slot, and each token keeps its fixed color as it may move between panels. A token is inside the region when it is in the middle shaded column. Which token occupies the region for the GREATEST number of panels across the four? If two are tied, choose the earlier color in red, green, blue, orange order. Answer 'red', 'green', 'blue', or 'orange'.
